note: Every synthetic number, figure and table in the north-star draft is listed here. A gap closes only when a sealed, receipt-bound measurement replaces its synthetic content, the \syn tags and SYNTHETIC tags for it are removed, and its claims are re-graded. Unknown or failed outcomes are reported, never filled in.

gaps.title: Learning procedures: first-proposal primary
replaces: the learning-procedure primary difference and its interval
family histogram in the primary figure
gaps.work_package: WP4 open synthesis in the existing domain; WP9 lock confirmation; WP10 run confirmation
gaps.acceptance: Locked confirmation on sealed families: family-weighted paired difference against the predeclared strongest non-search control (tree selector over the complete-program archive), 95% BCa family bootstrap with 10,000 resamples, failures retained, registered before the look.

gaps.title: Learning procedures: search-equivalent budget
replaces: the learning-procedure search-equivalent budget and its interval
gaps.work_package: WP3 strong controls; WP10 run confirmation
gaps.acceptance: Search arm run at k in {1,2,...,256} on the same sealed families and resource card; joint family bootstrap of the crossing; report a bound when no measured budget reaches the proposer.

gaps.title: Next experiment: frozen-history decision primary
replaces: the next-experiment primary difference and its interval
gaps.acceptance: Histories built by a predeclared behaviour policy independent of every compared method; each method emits exactly one point; paired family-level comparison against the predeclared strongest control with dependence retained.

gaps.title: Next experiment: closed-loop optimization
gaps.acceptance: Equal initial observations and evaluation budgets for every method; simple regret against a qualified reference; censored and failed runs retained; learned-optimizer baselines run from their released implementations where compatible.

gaps.title: Specification to CAD: first-proposal primary
gaps.domain: C: engineering specifications to CAD (C0, artifact)
replaces: the CAD primary difference and its interval
build validity, compliance and feasibility rates
gaps.work_package: WP6 CAD adapter and verifier; WP9; WP10
gaps.acceptance: Sealed specification families split by design lineage; build, geometric and specification checks before converged finite-element evaluation; failed builds in every denominator; independent solver on a predeclared subset.

gaps.title: Specification to CAD: search-equivalent simulation budget
replaces: the CAD search-equivalent budget and its interval
gaps.acceptance: Topology optimization followed by a fixed, declared CAD conversion, and template parameter search, each at k simulations on the same specifications; every simulation counted.

gaps.title: Frontier language models at one attempt
replaces: EurekaZero minus best frontier model, per domain
gaps.acceptance: Three frontier models receive the byte-identical information packet, no tools, no retries, one attempt; all attempts reported with metered usage and provider model identities.

gaps.title: Amortized baselines from the literature
replaces: OptFormer-class and ZeroShotOpt-class evaluations to target
gaps.acceptance: Released implementations run under their licences on the same sealed tasks; incompatible output contracts labelled as such rather than forced into the primary.

gaps.title: Representation and training ablations
replaces: direct-decoder, imitation-only, catalog, retrieval and search-only-teacher deltas
gaps.acceptance: Matched capacity, data and training compute for every arm; deltas against full EurekaZero on development families, then confirmed once.

gaps.title: Objective and constraint interventions
replaces: rate of appropriate change under objective swaps
gaps.acceptance: Observations held fixed while objectives or constraints change by a predeclared rule; appropriateness judged by the verifier under the new objective, not by inspection.

gaps.title: Shared versus separate models
gaps.acceptance: Joint and separate models with matched total data and compute; adapters counted; negative transfer reported.

gaps.title: EurekaZero-Native encoder
replaces: delta of the native-encoder model against the full model
gaps.acceptance: A state encoder trained inside the project with no third-party pretrained weights, otherwise identical recipe; same sealed families.

gaps.title: Experience scaling
replaces: search-equivalent budget against the fraction of training history
gaps.acceptance: Identical recipe trained on nested fractions of the frozen training history; each fraction evaluated on the same development panel, then the predeclared fractions on confirmation.

gaps.title: Controlled improvement rounds
replaces: search-equivalent budget by improvement round, with static-teacher control
gaps.acceptance: Fresh verified training examples produced each round; equal-compute static-data and static-teacher controls; confirmation families never enter the loop.

gaps.title: Novelty ladder and discovery opportunities
replaces: N0 to N6 counts and rates
gaps.acceptance: Frozen complete-artifact archive and enumerated rewrite rules before unblinding; blinded structural review; every attempt in the denominator.

gaps.title: Discovery dossier D-A1 (learning procedure)
replaces: removal and replacement effects on 60 reserved families
gaps.acceptance: Case chosen by the predeclared lowest-eligible-hash rule; removal and nearest-known replacement at matched capacity on 60 reserved families; lower interval bound above zero; prior-work review.

gaps.title: Discovery dossier D-C1 and physical validation
gaps.acceptance: Feature removal with other design freedoms controlled; a second evaluation setup; fabricated parts tested by a laboratory not involved in design.

gaps.title: Compute ledger and break-even
gaps.acceptance: Metered costs with nested measurements never added twice; quality-matched comparison; amortization volume stated.

gaps.title: CAD mass and compliance trade-off
replaces: relative mass at the compliance limit and its interval
gaps.acceptance: Domain-native metrics from converged finite-element evaluation for every method, infeasible designs shown, not dropped.

gaps.title: Confirmation rosters and registration
gaps.acceptance: Power from development-only variance; rosters, dependency graph and hashes frozen and registered publicly before any confirmation outcome is opened.

gaps.title: Model dimensions
gaps.work_package: WP7 development comparison of latent forms
gaps.acceptance: Dimensions fixed by a capacity- and compute-matched development comparison (128, 256 and 512 widths and a slot sequence), then frozen with the checkpoint identity.
